g.text: Figure 9: Shared Runtime Blast Radius: Single Failure Domain in 3Dex Modular Monolith
Scenario A: 3Dex Modular Monolith (Shared OS Process Blast Radius)
Scenario B: Microservices Architecture (Isolated Fault Domains)
Because all 8 business modules run inside the same OS process,
an uncaught exception or fatal memory exhaustion in any single module
terminates the entire application server. All features go offline simultaneously.
Dexie crash degrades AI recommendations gracefully.
Core authentication, model catalog, and purchasing
remain fully functional and accessible to users.
